invariants.rationale: Method takes a float parameter, and NaN is often undesired or filtered in APIs; may represent an invariant to ensure valid numeric argument.
prefWidth is always within the bounds of Java float, disallowing values outside the float domain.
PrefWidth parameter is a valid float (not NaN), but this is a tautology and should be avoided; primarily for example purposes.
At method entry, prefWidth could be any float (unless method has preconditions elsewhere).
